# v0.3.25 — Topics can do the work: files, commands and the rest of DSH's tools

## What's changed

- **Fixed: topics now have DSH's tools.** DSH gives a chat its file, command, search, web and other tools through an agent preset, which it attaches to every chat it opens. TheOne opened its topic sessions without one, so a topic had only TheOne's own three tools and answered that it could not read files or run commands, for example when asked to install a plugin. A new topic now gets the same preset as main chat, and an existing topic the preset it was created with (DSH's default when it has none), so topics have the same tools as an ordinary DSH chat.
- **New topics work in DSH's default workspace folder.** A topic started from main chat used to work in a hidden folder (`~/.dsh/theone/gateway`), where the files it made were hard to find. It now works where DSH puts chats that belong to no project, `Documents/deepseek-harness/default-workspace`, when you have that folder, and in the hidden folder otherwise. It never uses whichever project you used last, so nothing lands in one of your projects by accident. TheOne neither creates that folder nor adds its sessions to that workspace: the workspace's list, and where DSH opens your next chat, stay as they were. Topics organised from your existing chats keep working in those chats' folders.

TheOne only organises: it adds its own entries and views, and never changes your settings or your own chats.

Validation: automated tests (201) and type checks passed; checked in DSH that new and existing topics get the same 29 tools as main chat, including bash, read, write and edit, and that a new topic's session is created in the default workspace folder without being added to that workspace.

## 中文

- **修复：话题现在能用 DSH 的工具了。** DSH 给会话的文件、命令行、搜索、网页等工具，是通过「代理预设」挂上去的，它自己打开的每个会话都会挂。TheOne 以前打开话题会话时没挂预设，所以话题里只有 TheOne 自己的 3 个工具。比如让它装插件，它会回答说没法读写文件、也没法运行命令。现在新话题和主聊天用同一个预设；已有的话题沿用创建时的预设，没有记录的用 DSH 的默认预设。话题里的工具和普通 DSH 会话完全一样。
- **新话题在 DSH 的默认工作区里干活。** 以前从主聊天新开的话题，都在一个隐藏文件夹（`~/.dsh/theone/gateway`）里干活，生成的文件很难找到。现在，如果你有 DSH 专门放「不属于任何项目的聊天」的文件夹 `文稿/deepseek-harness/default-workspace`，新话题就在那里干活；没有的话，仍用原来的隐藏文件夹。它不会用你最近用过的项目，所以不会把文件误放进你的项目里。TheOne 既不会替你新建这个文件夹，也不会把自己的会话加进这个工作区：工作区里的会话列表、DSH 下次在哪里打开新会话，都和原来一样。从你已有会话整理出来的话题，照旧在原来的文件夹里干活。

TheOne 只做整理：它只添加自己的入口和视图，不改你的设置，也不改你自己的会话。

已通过自动化测试（201 项）和类型检查；并在 DSH 里实际确认：新话题和已有话题都拿到了和主聊天相同的 29 个工具（包括 bash、read、write、edit）；新话题的会话建在默认工作区的文件夹里，且没有被加进这个工作区。
